lead: Rajiv Gandhi was an Indian politician, born on 20 August 1944 in Mumbai.
He died on 21 May 1991 in Sriperumbudur at the age of 46.
He has held the office of Minister of External Affairs and Prime Minister of India and has been recognised with Order of Augusto César Sandino and Indira Gandhi Peace Prize.
The sections that follow break down Rajiv Gandhi's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Rajiv Gandhi — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Rajiv Gandhi was born on 20 August 1944 in Mumbai, and holds citizenship of India, British Raj and Dominion of India.
Public records name his father, Feroze Gandhi and his mother, Indira Gandhi. He is a sibling of Sanjay Gandhi.
He studied at Trinity College, Imperial College London, The Doon School and University of Cambridge.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi.

sections.heading: Rajiv Gandhi — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.

He has held the following offices: Minister of External Affairs (1987–1988), Prime Minister of India (1984–1989), Member of the Lok Sabha (1981–1991), Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha (1989–1990), President of the Indian National Congress (1984–1991) and Member of the 9th Lok Sabha (1989–1991). He is affiliated with Indian National Congress.

sections.heading: Rajiv Gandhi — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He was married to Sonia Gandhi (married 1969, until 1991).
He is a parent to Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Vadra.

sections.heading: Rajiv Gandhi — Net Worth: What Is Actually Verifiable
paras: Net-worth figures for Rajiv Gandhi circulate widely online, but almost none of them come from an audited or officially published source. BioStar does not invent or repeat unsourced numbers, so no dollar figure is stated on this page.
